1.consolidated_definition: . Atinar, acertar. Úsase más en sentido negativo. (En España, no dar pie con bola es equivocarse).
1.en_consolidated_definition: To hit the mark, to be correct. More commonly used in a negative sense. (In Spain, not to give anyone anything to work with is to make a mistake.)
